senses.en: the act of carrying something from one place to another
a vehicle
the legal transfer of property

ex.en: A horse-drawn cart was the only conveyance available in the village.
ex.zh: 馬車是村裡唯一的交通工具。

senses.en: friendly, lively, and enjoyable

ex.en: The dinner party had a warm, convivial atmosphere.
ex.zh: 這場晚宴的氣氛溫馨又熱鬧。

root.note: 一起生活、吃喝 → 歡樂的

senses.en: a coil or twist, such as a fold of the brain's surface
something complex and hard to follow

ex.en: I got lost in every convolution of the novel's plot.
ex.zh: 我迷失在這本小說錯綜複雜的情節裡。

root.note: 捲在一起 → 迴旋、複雜

senses.en: to roll or twist together

ex.en: The vines convolve around the old iron fence.
ex.zh: 藤蔓盤繞在老舊的鐵欄杆上。

senses.en: a group of vehicles or ships traveling together, often with protection

ex.en: A convoy of trucks carried food to the flooded towns.
ex.zh: 一支卡車車隊把食物運到淹水的城鎮。

senses.en: to shake violently and uncontrollably
to cause to laugh uncontrollably

ex.en: His jokes made the whole audience convulse with laughter.
ex.zh: 他的笑話讓全場觀眾笑得前仰後合。

senses.en: a sudden, violent, uncontrollable shaking of the body
a violent social or natural upheaval

ex.en: The child had a convulsion caused by a high fever.
ex.zh: 那個孩子因發高燒而抽搐。

senses.en: abundant; in large amounts

ex.en: She took copious notes during the lecture.
ex.zh: 她在課堂上做了大量的筆記。

mn: 想成 copy：可以複製很多份 → 大量的。

senses.en: a woman who flirts playfully

ex.en: In the old play, the coquette teases every young man in town.
ex.zh: 在那齣老戲裡，那位賣弄風情的女子挑逗鎮上每個年輕男子。

root.note: 像公雞般昂首炫耀的女子

senses.en: a decorative molding along the top of a wall or building

ex.en: Pigeons sat in a row along the stone cornice of the bank.
ex.zh: 鴿子在銀行的石造飛簷上排成一排。

senses.en: a horn-shaped container overflowing with fruit, symbolizing plenty
an abundant supply of good things

ex.en: The farmers market is a cornucopia of fresh produce.
ex.zh: 農夫市集裡新鮮蔬果應有盡有。

senses.en: a natural consequence or result
a statement that follows directly from one already proved

ex.en: Higher prices were a corollary of the fuel shortage.
ex.zh: 物價上漲是燃料短缺的必然結果。

senses.en: the ceremony of crowning a king or queen

ex.en: Millions watched the coronation on television.
ex.zh: 數百萬人透過電視收看加冕典禮。

senses.en: a small crown worn by nobles

ex.en: The duchess wore a jeweled coronet at the royal ball.
ex.zh: 公爵夫人在皇家舞會上戴著鑲寶石的小冠冕。

senses.en: relating to the body
a low-ranking officer in the army

ex.en: Corporal punishment is banned in schools in many countries.
ex.zh: 很多國家的學校禁止體罰。

senses.en: relating to a large company or business
shared by all members of a group

ex.en: She left her corporate job to open a bakery.
ex.zh: 她辭去公司的工作，開了一家麵包店。

root.note: 結合成一體的 → 公司的、團體的

senses.en: having a physical body; material rather than spiritual

ex.en: The ghost in the story has no corporeal form.
ex.zh: 故事中的鬼魂沒有實體。

senses.en: a large military unit
a group of people doing a particular activity

ex.en: The press corps waited outside for the president's statement.
ex.zh: 記者團在外面等候總統發表聲明。

mn: corps 唸 [kor]，p 和 s 不發音；別和 corpse（屍體）搞混。

senses.en: a dead body, especially of a human

ex.en: The detective knelt beside the corpse to look for clues.
ex.zh: 偵探跪在屍體旁尋找線索。

senses.en: (of a person) large and fat

ex.en: The corpulent innkeeper laughed as he poured our drinks.
ex.zh: 那位胖胖的旅店老闆一邊笑一邊幫我們倒飲料。

senses.en: a blood cell or other tiny body in an organism

ex.en: Each red corpuscle carries oxygen through the body.
ex.zh: 每個紅血球都在體內輸送氧氣。

senses.en: to have a relationship in which one thing affects or depends on another

ex.en: Studies show that sleep quality can correlate with school performance.
ex.zh: 研究顯示睡眠品質可能與學業表現相關。

senses.en: having a mutual relationship
either of two things closely related

ex.en: "Either" and "or" are correlative conjunctions.
ex.zh: either 和 or 是對等相關連接詞。

senses.en: able to be corrected or reformed

ex.en: The teacher believed every student was corrigible with enough patience.
ex.zh: 老師相信只要有足夠耐心，每個學生都能改過。

root.note: 可以扳直的 → 可改正的

mn: 反義字 incorrigible（無可救藥的）更常見。

senses.en: evidence that confirms a statement or theory

ex.en: Police needed corroboration before charging the suspect.
ex.zh: 警方在起訴嫌犯前需要佐證。

root.note: 使說法更有力 → 佐證

senses.en: to destroy or damage metal slowly by chemical action
to weaken or destroy gradually

ex.en: Salt water can corrode the metal parts of a boat.
ex.zh: 鹹水會腐蝕船上的金屬零件。

root.note: 一點一點啃掉 → 腐蝕

senses.en: the process of damage to metal or stone by chemical action

ex.en: The bridge was closed because of severe corrosion in its steel beams.
ex.zh: 這座橋因鋼樑嚴重鏽蝕而封閉。

senses.en: causing damage to metal or other materials by chemical action
harmful in a gradual way
senses.zh: 有破壞性的；逐漸侵蝕的

ex.en: Wear gloves when handling this corrosive cleaning product.
ex.zh: 使用這種腐蝕性清潔劑時請戴手套。

senses.en: able to be bribed or made dishonest

ex.en: A corruptible judge is a danger to the whole justice system.
ex.zh: 可被收買的法官對整個司法體系是一大威脅。

root.note: 可以被打破（原則）的 → 可收買的

senses.en: dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in power
the process of changing or damaging something

ex.en: The mayor promised to fight corruption in city hall.
ex.zh: 市長承諾要打擊市政府的貪腐。

root.note: 徹底破壞（道德） → 腐敗

senses.en: affecting only the appearance, not the basic nature
a product applied to improve appearance

ex.en: The changes to the plan are only cosmetic and solve nothing.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的修改只是表面功夫，什麼都沒解決。

root.note: 整理外表 → 化妝的、表面的

senses.en: relating to the universe
extremely large; vast

ex.en: Scientists study cosmic rays that reach Earth from distant stars.
ex.zh: 科學家研究從遙遠星體到達地球的宇宙射線。

senses.en: a theory or story about the origin of the universe

ex.en: Each ancient culture had its own cosmogony explaining how the world began.
ex.zh: 每個古文明都有自己解釋世界如何開始的創世說。

root.note: 宇宙的誕生 → 宇宙起源論

senses.en: the science that describes and maps the general features of the universe

ex.en: Medieval cosmography placed the Earth at the center of everything.
ex.zh: 中世紀的宇宙誌把地球放在萬物的中心。

senses.en: the science of the origin and development of the universe

ex.en: Modern cosmology suggests the universe began with the Big Bang.
ex.zh: 現代宇宙學認為宇宙起源於大霹靂。

senses.en: including people and influences from many different countries
(of a person) well traveled and sophisticated

ex.en: London is a cosmopolitan city where hundreds of languages are spoken.
ex.zh: 倫敦是個國際化的城市，人們說著數百種語言。

root.note: 世界公民的 → 國際化的

senses.en: the belief that all people belong to one world community

ex.en: The philosopher's cosmopolitanism led him to see himself as a citizen of the world.
ex.zh: 那位哲學家的世界主義讓他自視為世界公民。

senses.en: the universe seen as a well-ordered whole

ex.en: Humans have always wondered about their place in the cosmos.
ex.zh: 人類一直好奇自己在宇宙中的位置。

root.note: 有秩序的整體 → 宇宙

senses.en: a claim made in response to another claim, especially in a lawsuit

ex.en: The tenant filed a counter-claim against the landlord for unpaid repairs.
ex.zh: 房客對房東提出反訴，要求支付未處理的修繕費用。

senses.en: to act against something to reduce or cancel its effect

ex.en: Drinking water can help counteract the effects of the heat.
ex.zh: 喝水有助於抵消炎熱帶來的影響。

senses.en: to balance or offset by having an opposite effect
[ˋkaʊntɚˏbæləns] a weight or force that balances another

ex.en: Her calm nature helps counterbalance his quick temper.
ex.zh: 她沉穩的個性有助於平衡他的急性子。

senses.en: an accusation made in response to another accusation

ex.en: The senator answered the charge of lying with a countercharge of his own.
ex.zh: 那位參議員被指說謊，隨即提出反指控。

senses.en: made to look exactly like something valuable in order to deceive
to make a fake copy of something
a fake copy

ex.en: The store clerk spotted a counterfeit twenty-dollar bill.
ex.zh: 店員發現了一張偽造的二十元美鈔。

root.note: 對照著做出來的 → 仿冒

senses.en: a person or thing that has the same position or function as another in a different place
senses.zh: 對應的人或物；對口單位

ex.en: The foreign minister met with her Japanese counterpart in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 外交部長在東京與日本外相會面。

senses.en: to offset the effect of something by opposing action

ex.en: Strong local support may countervail the national trend.
ex.zh: 強大的地方支持可能會抵消全國性的趨勢。

parts.m: be strong 強（拉丁文 valere）

mn: 常見於經貿用語 countervailing duties（平衡稅）。

senses.en: (old use) an office where a business keeps its accounts

ex.en: In the old story, the king sat in his counting-house counting out his money.
ex.zh: 在那個老故事裡，國王坐在帳房裡數著他的錢。

senses.en: a person from the same country as someone else
a person who lives in the countryside

ex.en: The tennis star beat her own countryman in the final.
ex.zh: 那位網球明星在決賽中擊敗了自己的同胞。

senses.en: not deterred by danger or pain; brave

ex.en: It was courageous of her to speak up against the bully.
ex.zh: 她敢站出來對抗霸凌者，真的很勇敢。

root.note: 有心、有膽的 → 勇敢的

senses.en: a series of lessons in a subject
the direction or route taken
(of liquid) to flow quickly

ex.en: The ship changed course to avoid the storm.
ex.zh: 船隻改變航道以避開暴風雨。

root.note: 奔跑的路線 → 路線、課程

senses.en: (literary) a swift horse

ex.en: The knight rode into battle on a mighty courser.
ex.zh: 騎士騎著一匹駿馬奔赴戰場。

senses.en: polite and considerate behavior
a polite act or remark

ex.en: Out of courtesy, he let the elderly woman go first.
ex.zh: 出於禮貌，他讓那位老太太先走。

root.note: 宮廷中的禮儀 → 禮貌

senses.en: a formal agreement or promise, often legal or religious

ex.en: The nations signed a covenant to protect human rights.
ex.zh: 各國簽署了保護人權的公約。

root.note: 一起來達成的約定 → 盟約

senses.en: not openly shown or acknowledged; secret

ex.en: The spy agency ran a covert operation overseas.
ex.zh: 情報機構在海外執行了一項祕密行動。

root.note: 被蓋起來的 → 祕密的

mn: covert 和 cover（覆蓋）同源；反義字是 overt（公開的）。

senses.en: a small flock of birds, especially partridges
a small group of people

ex.en: A covey of quail burst out of the tall grass.
ex.zh: 一群鵪鶉從高高的草叢中飛竄而出。

parts.m: brood, sit on eggs 孵（拉丁文 cubare）

root.note: 同一窩孵出的鳥 → 一群

senses.en: to crouch down or shrink back in fear

ex.en: The dog would cower under the bed whenever it thundered.
ex.zh: 每次打雷，那隻狗都會縮到床底下。

senses.en: the person who steers a rowing boat and directs the rowers

ex.en: The coxswain shouted the rhythm to keep the rowers together.
ex.zh: 舵手大聲喊出節奏，讓划手們動作一致。

root.note: 小船上的僕役 → 舵手

senses.en: a steep, rugged cliff or rock

ex.en: An eagle built its nest high on a rocky crag.
ex.zh: 一隻老鷹把巢築在高高的岩壁上。

senses.en: the part of the skull that holds the brain

ex.en: The helmet protects the cranium from serious injury.
ex.zh: 安全帽保護顱骨免於嚴重受傷。

senses.en: lacking sensitivity, refinement, or intelligence

ex.en: Making jokes at a funeral would be crass.
ex.zh: 在喪禮上開玩笑是很粗俗的。

senses.en: a powerful desire for something

ex.en: Late at night I often have a craving for something sweet.
ex.zh: 深夜時我常常很想吃甜的東西。

senses.en: to make a high, harsh sound when moved or under pressure
a harsh, squeaking sound

ex.en: The old wooden stairs creak with every step.
ex.zh: 那座老舊的木樓梯每走一步都會嘎吱作響。

mn: creak（嘎吱聲）和 creek（小溪）同音。

senses.en: a place where dairy products such as butter and cheese are made or sold

ex.en: We bought fresh butter at the local creamery.
ex.zh: 我們在當地的乳品店買了新鮮奶油。

senses.en: thick, smooth, and rich like cream

ex.en: This soup is so creamy and delicious.
ex.zh: 這碗湯又濃郁又好喝。

senses.en: belief in or acceptance of something as true

ex.en: New evidence gave credence to the witness's story.
ex.zh: 新證據讓目擊者的說法更加可信。

mn: 常見搭配 give/lend credence to：使…更可信。

senses.en: able to be believed; convincing

ex.en: The reporter checked that every source was credible.
ex.zh: 記者確認每一個消息來源都可信。

mn: credible 是「別人信得過」，credulous 是「自己太好騙」。

senses.en: a set of beliefs or principles, especially religious

ex.en: The club welcomes people of every race and creed.
ex.zh: 這個社團歡迎所有種族與信仰的人。

parts.m: believe 相信（拉丁文 credo「我相信」）

senses.en: a place where dead bodies are burned

ex.en: The family gathered at the crematory to say goodbye.
ex.zh: 家人聚集在火葬場做最後的道別。

root.note: 焚燒的地方 → 火葬場

senses.en: a deep, open crack in a glacier or ice sheet

ex.en: The climbers roped together in case someone fell into a crevasse.
ex.zh: 登山者用繩子互相綁著，以防有人掉進冰隙。

mn: crevasse 是冰河上的大裂縫；crevice 是岩石或牆上的小縫。

senses.en: a narrow opening or crack in a rock or wall

ex.en: A lizard slipped into a crevice in the stone wall.
ex.zh: 一隻蜥蜴溜進了石牆的縫隙裡。

senses.en: a standard by which something is judged

ex.en: Price was not the only criterion we used to choose a laptop.
ex.zh: 價格不是我們挑筆電的唯一標準。

senses.en: a detailed analysis and evaluation of something
to evaluate in a detailed way

ex.en: The art teacher gave a thoughtful critique of each painting.
ex.zh: 美術老師對每幅畫都給了用心的評析。

senses.en: plates, dishes, and cups made of earthenware or china

ex.en: We wrapped the crockery in newspaper before moving.
ex.zh: 搬家前我們用報紙把碗盤包好。

senses.en: a container in which metals are heated to very high temperatures
a severe test or trial that produces change

ex.en: The war was a crucible that shaped a new generation of leaders.
ex.zh: 這場戰爭是一座熔爐，淬鍊出新一代的領袖。

senses.en: a long, determined campaign for a cause
one of the medieval Christian military expeditions to the Holy Land
to campaign energetically for a cause

ex.en: She led a crusade against plastic waste in her town.
ex.zh: 她在鎮上發起了一場反塑膠垃圾運動。

root.note: 背負十字架的出征 → 十字軍 → 運動

senses.en: an animal with a hard shell and jointed legs, such as a crab or shrimp

ex.en: A lobster is a crustacean that lives on the ocean floor.
ex.zh: 龍蝦是一種生活在海底的甲殼類動物。

senses.en: having a hard shell; relating to crustaceans

ex.en: The tide pool was full of small crustaceous creatures.
ex.zh: 潮池裡滿是小小的甲殼類生物。

senses.en: a text written in code

ex.en: The newspaper prints a cryptogram for readers to solve every Sunday.
ex.zh: 報紙每週日都會刊登一則密碼謎題讓讀者破解。

root.note: 隱藏起來的文字 → 密碼文

senses.en: to form crystals
(of ideas) to become clear and definite

ex.en: Traveling abroad helped crystallize her plans for the future.
ex.zh: 出國旅行讓她對未來的計畫變得明確。

root.note: 變成晶體 → 結晶、明確化

senses.en: a short, thick stick used as a weapon
to beat with a cudgel

ex.en: The guard carried a heavy cudgel on his belt.
ex.zh: 守衛腰間掛著一根沉重的棍棒。

mn: 片語 take up the cudgels for：挺身為…辯護。

senses.en: relating to cooking or the kitchen

ex.en: He went to culinary school to become a professional chef.
ex.zh: 他就讀烹飪學校，想成為專業廚師。

senses.en: to select from a large quantity
to reduce an animal population by killing some

ex.en: The editor will cull the best stories from hundreds of submissions.
ex.zh: 編輯將從數百篇投稿中挑出最好的故事。

senses.en: deserving blame

ex.en: The court found the company culpable for the chemical spill.
ex.zh: 法院判定這家公司應為化學物外洩負責。

senses.en: a person responsible for a crime or wrongdoing
the cause of a problem

ex.en: A loose wire turned out to be the culprit behind the power outage.
ex.zh: 原來一條鬆脫的電線才是停電的元兇。

parts.m: ready 準備好（古法文 prest）

senses.en: a tunnel or pipe that carries water under a road

ex.en: Heavy rain flooded the culvert under the highway.
ex.zh: 大雨淹沒了公路底下的涵洞。

senses.en: greed for money or possessions

ex.en: The con artist took advantage of his victims' cupidity.
ex.zh: 那個騙子利用了受害者的貪婪。

root.note: 強烈的慾望 → 貪婪（邱比特 Cupid 同源）

senses.en: able to be cured

ex.en: Many cancers are curable if found early.
ex.zh: 許多癌症若及早發現是可以治癒的。

senses.en: a person in charge of a museum or collection

ex.en: The curator chose which paintings would appear in the exhibit.
ex.zh: 策展人挑選哪些畫作會出現在展覽中。

senses.en: a rare, unusual, or interesting object

ex.en: I bought a small curio from the antique shop as a gift for my aunt.
ex.zh: 我在古董店買了一件小古玩送給阿姨。

root.note: 引人好奇的東西 → 珍品

senses.en: written with the letters joined together
handwriting with joined letters

ex.en: My grandmother writes letters in beautiful cursive script.
ex.zh: 我奶奶用漂亮的草寫體寫信。

root.note: 筆跑得很快 → 草寫的

senses.en: hasty and not thorough

ex.en: After a cursory glance at the menu, he ordered a burger.
ex.zh: 他匆匆瞄了一眼菜單，就點了漢堡。

root.note: 跑過去看一下 → 草率的

senses.en: rudely brief in speech

ex.en: She gave a curt reply and walked away.
ex.zh: 她冷冷地簡短回了一句就走了。

senses.en: to reduce or limit something

ex.en: The school had to curtail after-school programs because of budget cuts.
ex.zh: 學校因預算刪減，不得不縮減課後活動。

mn: 想成 cut + tail：把尾巴剪掉 → 縮減。

senses.en: a woman's bow made by bending the knees
to make such a bow

ex.en: The little girl learned to curtsy before meeting the queen.
ex.zh: 小女孩在晉見女王前學會了行屈膝禮。

root.note: 表示禮貌的動作 → 屈膝禮

senses.en: the curve traced by a point on the rim of a rolling circle

ex.en: A point on a rolling bicycle wheel traces a cycloid.
ex.zh: 滾動的腳踏車輪上的一點會畫出一條擺線。

senses.en: a young swan

ex.en: A gray cygnet followed its mother across the pond.
ex.zh: 一隻灰色的小天鵝跟著媽媽游過池塘。

senses.en: believing that people are motivated only by self-interest
senses.zh: 憤世嫉俗的；認為人都自私的

senses.en: doubtful that something will be worthwhile

ex.en: After many broken promises, voters have become cynical about politicians.
ex.zh: 經歷多次跳票後，選民對政客變得憤世嫉俗。

root.note: 源自古希臘「犬儒學派」→ 憤世嫉俗的

senses.en: a belief that people act only out of self-interest; distrust

ex.en: His cynicism made it hard for him to trust anyone's kindness.
ex.zh: 他的憤世嫉俗讓他很難相信任何人的善意。

senses.en: a person or thing that is the center of attention or admiration

ex.en: In her red gown, she was the cynosure of the entire ballroom.
ex.zh: 穿著紅色禮服的她，成了整個舞廳的焦點。

root.note: 「狗尾巴」指小熊座（北極星所在），水手都盯著它 → 眾人注目的焦點

senses.en: bold and willing to take risks
adventurous courage

ex.en: The firefighters made a daring rescue from the burning building.
ex.zh: 消防員從失火的大樓中進行了一次大膽的救援。

senses.en: (literary) growing dark; in the dark

ex.en: The poet walked alone across the darkling plain.
ex.zh: 詩人獨自走過昏暗的平原。
